title: cpmp
description: Lilly Chronic Pain Master Protocol (CPMP, H0P-MC-CPMP): the master protocol and its intervention-specific appendices (ISAs), each posted on ClinicalTrials.gov under its own NCT ID. The ISA SoAs are delta schedules on top of the master and disease-state addendum (DSA) SoAs; the three DSAs are not public. Protocol folders are named by NCT ID; source documents are the sponsor-posted protocols on ClinicalTrials.gov.
